description: This file defines extension methods for the WindowsDriver class in the CalculatorUITestFramework, adding retry logic for element finding and window switching functionality.

classes.name: WindowsDriverExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for WindowsDriver to handle element retrieval with retry logic and window switching.

methods.name: TryFindElementByAccessibilityId
methods.description: Attempts to find an element by AccessibilityId with retry logic if the window has been closed.

methods.name: TryFindElementByClassName
methods.description: Attempts to find an element by class name with retry logic if the window has been closed.

methods.name: SwitchToCurrentWindowHandle
methods.description: Switches the driver to the first available window handle for the current session.
